approval_source: Pengguna memilih C — Ruang Bersama melalui jawaban terstruktur pada 20 Oktober 2026.
approval_scope: Arah visual dan mockup Beranda; bukan persetujuan otomatis atas layar turunan atau bukti aplikasi berjalan.
prompt: Use case: ui-mockup. Create one polished high-fidelity portrait native mobile HOME SCREEN design for Cash Flow, an Indonesian shared household money-recording app. This is a flat edge-to-edge app artboard, aspect ratio 390:844, not a photographed phone, no perspective, no decorative background or extra surrounding devices. Show a plausible iPhone safe-area status bar and a four-destination native bottom tab bar: Beranda, Transaksi, Anggaran, Keluarga. Text must be clean, readable Indonesian, using system sans typography and tabular money digits. Household identity Keluarga Budi is visible in the top navigation, with a small disclosure control for switching households. A single visible plus button in the top toolbar adds transactions; it is an action, not a fifth tab. Main visual task is reading the household's recorded balance and cashflow, then adding a transaction. These are synthetic demo data, so show a small understated 'Data contoh' label. Exact financial data: Saldo tercatat Rp12.672.500; period Oktober 2026; Pemasukan Rp8.000.000; Pengeluaran Rp327.500; Arus kas Rp7.672.500. The balance is labeled 'Saat ini', and the period metrics labeled 'Bulan ini'. Anggaran Belanja: Rp325.000 dari Rp1.500.000, Sisa Rp1.175.000. Recent activity is a single transfer Bank Keluarga → E-wallet Rp500.000 with Biaya admin Rp2.500 as its subordinate detail, a Belanja transaction −Rp325.000, and Gaji +Rp8.000.000. If showing account balances, Bank Keluarga Rp12.172.500 and E-wallet Rp500.000. All money values must match exactly, no made-up bank connectivity, no claim actual bank balance. Prioritize clear hierarchy and realistic 44pt touch targets. No illustrations, no marketing claims, no invented charts, no QR code, no giant logo, no gradients. Direction C: WARM SHARED HOME. Warm near-white background #F7F3F0, white cards, text #243731, restrained deep teal actions #116C61. The structure is a welcoming modern consumer app: one broad soft-cornered main balance card, two compact income and expense summary tiles in a row, a distinct friendly budget panel with amount and progress, then a short recent activity list. A small overlapping pair of member-initial avatars beside household identity shows shared use. Keep the financial labels exact and avoid making every region equally loud. Large comfortable rounded controls, natural system sans and generous touch spacing. All interactive controls use teal; other surfaces neutral. No gradient, no cash-card illustration. Make this composition clearly distinct from a ruled statement or a journal.
